def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    cars = image_patch.find("black car")
    street_patches = image_patch.find("narrow street")
    
    if not cars or not street_patches:
        return []
    
    street_center = (street_patches[0].horizontal_center + street_patches[-1].horizontal_center) / 2
    
    left_cars = [car for car in cars if car.horizontal_center < street_center]
    right_cars = [car for car in cars if car.horizontal_center >= street_center]
    
    return left_cars + right_cars
